core_idea: MultiCrack Office Rep Faust is a Damage Dealer applying sustained Charge, Coin Power pressure with consistent skill stats.
playstyle_guide:
**S1 — 40Y-3 Activation** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- Consume 5 Charge Count to gain Coin Power +2
- Gain +3 Charge Count

**S2 — Charge Countercurrent** (BP 4, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- At 5~9 Charge Count, consume 2(10 - current Charge Count)% HP to raise Charge Count to 10; [On Use] Consume 10 Charge Count to gain Coin Power +2
- At 3+ Reson. including this Skill, consume all Charge Count on self and deal +(Charge + 3)% damage for every Charge Count consumed by this Skill (max 120%)

**S3 — 40Y-3 Charge** (BP 4, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low / Average stacked).
- Coin Power +1 for every Charge (max 4)
- Gain +(Charge + 4) Charge Count (max 7)
- At 3+ Charge, deal +4% damage for every Charge (max 20%)

Combat passive — **Electrocurrent Dismantling**: Gain 1 Charge every time this unit consumes 10 cumulative Charge Count in this Encounter.
  - At 2+ Charge, deal +(Charge x 3)% damage (max 15%).
  - If the target is at less than 50% HP, deal +(Charge x 5)% more damage (max 25%).
